correctness.rationale: Independent replay /tmp/opencode/check_majority_independent.py built all transitions by bitboard swaps along the four XOR dimensions and strict majority of the five bitboards (self plus four neighbors); then tested the first t with X_(t+2)=X_t separately for each word, and distinguished p=1 by X_(t+1)=X_t. Exhaustion found every pinned word in the eleven cells (t=0..6, counts by p=1:425,5490,12713,5171,1224,198,24; by p=2:602,3187,3562,172,0,0,0). There are 425 fixed points and 602/2=301 two-cycle orbits, with no others. All 24 words first entering at t=6 land at word 1: the wording 'attainable at time six' is read in its first-entry census context, not as a claim about the image of P^6. The witness 35537->35025->32977->209->81->17->1 certifies P^7 != P^5 and exhaustion gives P^8=P^6. All-one and word-1 basins have sizes 9383 and 3696. Unpinned replay gave max t=4 both for all 65536 starts and for the same 32768 odd starts, which have all-one basin 8229. The matched sets have difference 1154 and reverse difference zero. The order-preservation proof compares both iterates starting at the same x, because clamping dominates an ordinary update and the ordinary map is increasing. No inference about eventual fixedness of two-cycle starts or time to consensus.

evidence: On a degree-four cube, majority with tie retention is strict majority of the four neighbors plus current self; for the pin the update is a constant, not an ordinary self-loop. The proper trajectory statistic is first entry into a period, not time to consensus.
Kaaser et al. use synchronous ordinary tie-retaining majority. Mukhopadhyay et al. use Poisson updates and randomly sampled neighbors in a fully connected population.

value.rationale: Single-vertex permanent forcing and the canonical even-degree cube make a specific natural intervention/relaxation test. On the same starts this intervention increases the all-one basin by exactly 1154 without loss yet lengthens the worst first-periodic-entry time from four to six, while a highly polarized equilibrium still attracts 3696. It is a sharp finite witness that monotone improvement of consensus attraction does not imply faster worst relaxation, with a full reusable entry-period census; not an empirical social claim or an all-dimensional result.
